decision.explanation: Each of these dates refers to the construction or completion of a Delta Upsilon Fraternity House in different locations. Document D1S7 states the Ann Arbor, Michigan house was completed in 1903; D2S7 notes another Ann Arbor house completed in 1921; D3S2 describes a Champaign, Illinois house built in 1926-27; and D4S7 indicates an Ames, Iowa house completed in 1930. These are distinct referents and do not conflict.
